claims.text: The Beau-Rivage opened in 1865.

findings.quote: The Beau-Rivage opened in 1865.

claims.text: Beau-Rivage Geneva is at 13 quai du Mont-Blanc in Geneva.

findings.quote: 13, quai du Mont-Blanc, 1201 Geneva, Switzerland

claims.text: The hotel faces Lake Geneva from the Quai du Mont-Blanc, looking across to the Jet d'Eau.

findings.quote: You're halfway down the Quai du Mont-Blanc, on Lake Geneva's rive droite , facing the water.
findings.note: on the quai facing the lake

findings.quote: opposite, the mesmeric plume of the Jet d'Eau

claims.text: The Mayer family owned the hotel for 155 years.

findings.quote: For 155 years it was owned by the Mayer family.

claims.text: At the end of 2020 the Mayers sold the hotel to another family, the Casacubertas.

findings.quote: Then, at the end of 2020, the Mayers sold the hotel to another family, the Casacubertas, from

claims.text: Rooms mix Victorian, Edwardian, Art Nouveau and Art Deco design elements, and vary in mood from room to room.

findings.quote: there is a good deal of modulation in mood and tone between individual rooms , depending on the size, situation and particular admixture of Victorian, Edwardian, Art Nouveau and Art Deco design elements.

claims.text: Le Chat-Botte, the main fine-dining restaurant, opened in 1967.

findings.quote: The main fine-dining restaurant, Le Chat-Botté, opened in 1967

claims.text: Le Patara, downstairs, is a Thai restaurant.

findings.quote: Downstairs is a Thai restaurant, Le Patara.

claims.text: The hotel uses GeniLac, a network that uses Lake Geneva water to cool and heat buildings.

findings.quote: It has adopted the so-called GeniLac programme, a thermal-exchange network that uses water from Lake Geneva to cool and heat local buildings.

claims.text: The entire hotel is wheelchair-accessible, with special entrances off the Quai du Mont-Blanc to the lobby and key public areas.

findings.quote: The entire hotel is wheelchair-accessible, with special entrances off the Quai du Mont-Blanc to the lobby and the key public areas

claims.text: Baby cots are free with prior reservation.

findings.quote: Baby cots are available free of charge with prior reservation.

claims.text: Pets are accepted with the hotel's prior approval, at an extra charge.

findings.quote: Pets are accepted subject to the Hotel's prior approval and incur additional charges.

claims.text: In 1898 Empress Elisabeth of Austria, a guest at the hotel, was stabbed outside it and died in her suite shortly after.

findings.quote: In 1898, Elisabeth, Empress Consort of Austria was stabbed outside the Beau-Rivage by an Italian anarchist
She was a guest at the hotel at the time and died in her suite shortly after the attack.

claims.text: A cabinet holds a pair of Empress Elisabeth's gloves and a piece of bloodstained ribbon.

findings.quote: There is a cabinet containing a pair of her gloves and a piece of bloodstained ribbon.

claims.text: The outdoor restaurant La Terrasse becomes La Terrasse Alpine in winter, with heated vintage gondola cabins from Gstaad.

findings.quote: he oversees the outdoor restaurant La Terrasse—which becomes La Terrasse Alpine in the winter months, with heated vintage gondola cabins from Gstaad.

claims.text: The hotel holds more than 150 angels in various forms, painted, sculpted and carved.

findings.quote: The Beau-Rivage has a permanent population of more than 150 angels in various forms—painted, sculpted, carved.

claims.text: Albertine's, the little bar off the lobby, was formerly a reading room.

findings.quote: Albertine's, the little bar that you pass on your way from the lobby
Formerly a reading room

claims.text: The spa is a single treatment room, the Bellefontaine Suite, where one therapist looks after one guest at a time.

findings.quote: the Beau-Rivage makes do with a single treatment room—its Bellefontaine Suite—in which one therapist takes care of one guest at a time.

claims.text: Rooms are available from 3 p.m. on arrival day and must be vacated by noon on departure day.

findings.quote: Rooms are available from 3:00 p.m. on the day of arrival and must be vacated no later than 12:00 noon on the day of departure.

claims.text: The Geneva cantonal tourist tax is charged on top of the room rate.

findings.quote: The Geneva Cantonal tourist tax and any services not expressly included shall be charged in addition
